laws: YAML 1.2 Core null and boolean spellings resolve independently
decimal, binary, octal and hexadecimal integers preserve signed and unsigned ranges
finite decimal and scientific floats are accepted while non-finite values are rejected
custom tags, aliases, anchors and merge keys are rejected by the scalar boundary
canonical text quoting is selected without consulting the production parser
canonical mappings sort UTF-8 keys and reject duplicate keys
binary values use padded standard Base64
canonical rendering is idempotent for every bounded generated value
bounded malformed inputs produce deterministic independent errors
bounded replays never exceed the input, action, node or scalar budgets
valid and invalid replay counts remain balanced
reference values have deterministic depth and node observations
reader fragments preserve event order across one-byte boundaries
terminal reader and writer states reject later operations
the model is panic-free under repeated deterministic replay
model.oracle: independent bounded YAML Core scalar and canonical-value model with deterministic malformed replay

test.oracle: independent model, scalar stdlib tests and hosted regression suites agree on values, canonical bytes, errors and terminal state

fuzz.oracle: panic-free deterministic replay, independent canonical bytes, production parse/re-encode stability and explicit bounds

sanitization.reason: The independent model, scalar stdlib and hosted regression lane use safe Rust; this block does not promote generic native AOT or sanitizer coverage.
